factor_specs.formula: Z_Score of -sd(CAPM_residuals_252d). Lower IVOL = higher Z_Score.
factor_specs.lag_rule: Rolling 252d daily returns, Date <= sig_date. PIT C1/C2.
factor_specs.neutralization: None (IVOL contains sector information; sector-neutral removes signal)
factor_specs.economic_rationale: Ang-Hodrick-Xing-Zhang (2006): idiosyncratic vol cross-section anomaly. Limits-to-arbitrage mechanism. Regime-conditional gating: crisis amplification.
Complementary vol proxy. Short-window version responds faster to regime shift.

ax001_v2_eval.mdd_complement_note: Low IVOL expected to reduce STR_1715 MDD via partial decorrelation in crisis
